image_description: An underwater close-up shot of a large cetacean, identified as a grey whale. The image focuses on the head and anterior body section. Visible features include the arched rostrum, mottled dark grey skin covered in white barnacle patches (callosities), and a broad pectoral flipper extending from the side. The lighting is dim and blue-tinted, typical of underwater photography.
